page_title: ATA 0-0 GEN | Atalanta v Genoa 02/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' A rebound falls at the feet of Ederson (Atalanta), whose promising strike from long range flies a few inches wide of the right post! What a great effort!
90+6' The corner from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is hurriedly cleared.

90+6' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+4' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90+2' Corner kicks – 5:2. The fouls committed statistics – 14:10.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Junior Messias (Genoa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) swings in a cross from the corner, but Justin Bijlow reads it well and gathers the ball.

90' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
88' Junior Messias (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' The resulting corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
87' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Genoa are going to take it.
86' Substitution. Aaron Martin (Genoa) in, Stefano Sabelli out.
86' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replacing Vitinha.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yunus Musah (Atalanta) is coming onto the pitch as Davide Zappacosta cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

79' What a great touch by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.
78' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
76' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replaces Marten de Roon.
76' A substitution has been made. Charles De Ketelaere is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
76' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
75' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

75' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Justin Bijlow is alert and denies him with a nice save. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.

73' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
73' Ivano Pezzuto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) brought his opponent down. Genoa are awarded a free kick.
71' The total number of attempts is 11:7. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 6:2.
70' That will be all from Jeff Ekhator who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa).
69' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Amorim and he is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).

66' Good touch by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
66' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) works the corner short.

66' Giacomo Raspadori nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance. Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.
64' Ederson (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Ivano Pezzuto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

63' Ederson (Atalanta) receives the ball and fires a first-time shot from long range. His brilliant effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Justin Bijlow, who pulls off a stunning save! Justin Bijlow makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
62' Nicola Zalewski picks out Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
58' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
57' It is time for a substitution. Isak Hien (Atalanta) is on for Berat Djimsiti.
57' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Gianluca Scamacca is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).
57' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Ivano Pezzuto signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Atalanta.
57' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
56' That's the end of the game for Lorenzo Colombo, who is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
54' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.

51' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) after he collected a pass and unleashed a daisy-cutter. The ball was directed into the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
49' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Justin Bijlow easily makes the save.
49' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Justin Bijlow with a brilliant diving save!
42' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jeff Ekhator (Genoa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
41' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
40' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
38' Justin Bijlow pulls off a great save to deny Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
35' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Ederson wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
33' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
31' 3:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
29' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) attacks the corner from Amorim in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
29' Amorim (Genoa) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
28' Lorenzo Colombo does a good job setting up Vitinha (Genoa) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.

26' A big opportunity is wasted by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Justin Bijlow pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
25' A pass into the penalty area from Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
24' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
24' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
23' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Justin Bijlow punches the ball away.
22' Amorim (Genoa) brings an opponent down and Ivano Pezzuto interrupts the game. Atalanta win a free kick.
19' Ivano Pezzuto shows a yellow card to Amorim (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
17' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' The ball possession at the moment is 52:48.
14' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Justin Bijlow comes off his line to gather the ball.

13' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Ederson was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
11' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
10' Amorim (Genoa) was too forceful with his tackle and Ivano Pezzuto interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Atalanta.
9' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) sends a long ball forward to Vitinha, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The linesman signals a throw-in for Atalanta.
8' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. Justin Bijlow is alert and makes a good save to deny him.
7' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
7' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
6' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a great save to deny Vitinha (Genoa), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Ivano Pezzuto will supervise the game today.
